name: How often should I clean my deck?

mainEntity.name: How often should I clean my deck?

acceptedAnswer.text: Cleaning frequency depends on your local climate and deck usage. In areas like Berkeley or Oakland, a thorough cleaning at least once a year is recommended to remove dirt, pollen, and mildew. If your deck is heavily used, under trees, or in a damp environment, you might consider cleaning it semi-annually. Regular sweeping can help prevent debris accumulation between deep cleans.
acceptedAnswer.description: Clean your deck at least once a year, or semi-annually if heavily used or in a damp environment.
